description: Replace the large-matrix PyTorch call path with direct CUDA library integration and in-place output reuse, dispatching large n to lower-overhead cuSOLVER or cuBLAS primitives while preserving the single-file submission contract.
Direct row-major cuSOLVER Spotrf/potrfBatched extension; build compiled but import failed because libtorch_cuda_linalg.so lacked a runtime search path
Direct row-major cuSOLVER Spotrf/potrfBatched with upper-triangle factorization and Torch in-place triangular cleanup; validation passed all official and variation-guard cases
Dispatch direct row-major cuSOLVER only for n>=4096 and use Xpotrf for single matrices while retaining potrfBatched for batch>1; validation passed

For n>=4096, raw-clone symmetric inputs, run lower Xpotrf/potrfBatched, zero the row-major lower half, and return a transposed F-contiguous view; avoids the physical C-to-F input transpose; validation passed
Extend raw-clone lower cuSOLVER path from n>=4096 to n>=2048; validation passed and both n=2048 benchmark shapes used direct potrfBatched
Extend raw-clone lower cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=1024, covering low- and high-batch n=1024 shapes; validation passed
Extend raw-clone lower cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=512; direct potrfBatched reduced the high-batch n=512 shape to 3104.226 us in this run; validation passed
Extend raw-clone lower cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=256; direct path measured 259.841 us for batch=64,n=256; validation passed
Extend raw-clone lower cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=128; validation passed; benchmark observed a uniform slowdown including untouched n=32/64 PyTorch shapes

Pass persistent shape-scoped per-input output buffers into the n>=256 direct cuSOLVER path, replacing per-call output allocation while retaining raw device copy and lower-factor transpose view; validation and input-variation guard passed

Cache cuSOLVER batched device-pointer arrays per persistent output plus a shape-scoped info tensor; validation passed; n=256 benchmark had one 2.92 ms outlier among 200 runs and aggregate measured 1997.375 us
For single matrices, query classic Spotrf workspace once per shape and reuse it across calls, removing repeated Xpotrf parameter/workspace setup; validation passed

Use looped classic Spotrf with one persistent shared workspace for batch<=4,n>=1024, retaining potrfBatched otherwise; validation passed; batch=2,n=2048 measured 1271.261 us and batch=2,n=4096 measured 2913.142 us
Extend looped Spotrf crossover to batch<=8 for n>=2048; validation passed; batch=8,n=2048 measured 5110.942 us versus 4777.607 us with potrfBatched in the preceding looped-low-batch trial
Attempt eight cached cuSOLVER handles on independent CUDA streams for batch=8,n=2048; frozen validation gate rejected the submission because CUDA stream references are banned

Use triu_out to copy only cuSOLVER's consumed source triangle and zero the unused half in one kernel, removing full output copy plus post-factor triu cleanup; retain looped Spotrf for batch<=4,n>=1024; validation passed
Extend fused-prep direct cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=128; validation passed; batch=256,n=128 measured 145.919 us including one ~2.99 ms outlier among 200 runs (best 131.394 us)
Extend fused-prep direct cuSOLVER dispatch to n>=64; validation passed; batch=1024,n=64 measured 106.486 us including one 2.81 ms outlier among 200 runs (best 92.736 us)
Extend fused-prep direct cuSOLVER dispatch to all n>=32 benchmark shapes; validation passed; batch=4096,n=32 measured 97.669 us versus prior PyTorch-path runs around 112.9 us

Enable CUSOLVER_FP32_EMULATED_BF16X9_MATH before workspace query and execution; validation and all benchmark reconstruction checks passed; n=32768 measured 132299.355 us versus 215173.793 us in the preceding default-math trial

Force CUDA_EMULATION_STRATEGY_EAGER in addition to BF16x9 FP32 math mode; validation and benchmark reconstruction checks passed; n=32768 measured 133462.913 us versus 132299.355 us under the default performant strategy

Restore default BF16x9 emulation strategy and cache cuSOLVER math-mode setup once per handle; validation and reconstruction check pass. Measured 1597.742630 us versus EAGER 1600.139223 us and uncached default best 1597.563015 us.

Best commit 20835bf measured 1597.563015 us, 25.82% below the 2153.690 us baseline (1.348x speedup), with all 17 validation cases, input-variation guard, and 15 reconstruction checks passing. Major effects: lower-factor plus transpose view reached 2138.390 us; extending direct cuSOLVER to n>=2048 reached 2030.793 and progressively to all n>=32 reached 1655.768; persistent output reuse reached 1995.729; pointer/info reuse was neutral; looped Spotrf for batch<=4,n>=1024 reached 1726.897; fused triu copy/zero reached 1710.970; BF16x9 FP32 emulation reached 1597.563 and cut n32768 to about 132.30 ms. Forced EAGER regressed to 1600.139; once-per-handle math-mode setup measured 1597.743. Continue with a combine brief testing these cache/fused-copy/low-batch schedule ideas alongside other workers, submit 20835bf to the leaderboard, and investigate guard-compatible concurrency or finer cuSOLVER crossover/emulation choices.
